notes.title: New Prototype Trailer 🤩
notes.content:
Hey Pilots!

We celebrate #trailertuesday with a brand new Prototype Trailer. The music track, a few scenes and some of the timing is the same as the very first early preview trailer we made. Can you spot the old stuff? And more importantly; can you spot the progress we've made? 

[previewyoutube=8nZmHZRa2ZM;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: First Public Showing!
notes.content:
[b]Exciting news:[/b] You can play our super-duper-early demo on-site at [url=https://www.awesomegames.show/showcasing]Tomorrow's Awesome Games Showcase[/url] at [url=https://www.copenhagengamingweek.dk]Copenhagen Gaming Week[/url] already on January 12-14.

It's the first public showing of the game, and we're excited, nervous and obsessing over priorities and time to get everything as playable as possible.

Bring a friend, come say hi, play the demo and tell us what you think🧐 We hope to see you there!
